title: Lighter One-Pot Butter Chicken (Murgh Makhani)
hook: Friday night butter chicken, lightened up: one pot, 30 minutes, no heavy cream
benefit: High in protein, with a fraction of the butter and cream of takeout
ingredients: 1 1/2 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs, cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces
1 tsp Kashmiri chili powder or sweet paprika
1 tbsp dried fenugreek leaves (kasuri methi), optional
Chopped cilantro and cooked brown rice, to serve
steps: Stir the yogurt, lemon juice, garam masala, turmeric, cumin, chili powder and salt. Coat the chicken and marinate 15 minutes (or overnight).
Heat the ghee in a large deep skillet over medium-high. Sear the chicken in two batches, 3 minutes per side, until browned. Move it to a plate.
Lower the heat to medium. Cook the onion 5 minutes, then the garlic, ginger, tomato paste and coriander for 1 minute.
Add the tomato sauce and broth, scraping up the browned bits. Simmer 5 minutes, then blend smooth with an immersion blender if you like.
Add the cauliflower and the chicken with its juices. Simmer uncovered 12 to 15 minutes, until the cauliflower is tender and the chicken reaches 165F.
Off the heat, stir in the coconut milk, butter, fenugreek and honey. Top with cilantro, serve over brown rice. Keeps 4 days; freezes 2 months.
vo_steps: Marinate the chicken in yogurt, garam masala, turmeric and cumin for fifteen minutes.
Sear it three minutes a side, then set it aside.
Onion for five minutes, then garlic, ginger, tomato paste and coriander.
Add tomato sauce and broth, simmer five minutes, blend it smooth.
Add cauliflower and the chicken. Simmer twelve to fifteen minutes.
Off the heat, stir in coconut milk and a tablespoon of butter. Done.
